probeLimit: Deterministic automated input policies; these are not human completion rates or universal survival-time bounds.

results.name: Uses exported swept collision helper and preserves campaign API
Nothing starts, drifts, or fires before the first launch
One press launches one ball; cooldown blocks repeats and allows active firing
Steering is disabled and cannot change trajectories or supply charge
Ordinary buds do not start a cascade or create automatic balls
Only a final relay hit chains at most two neighbors and chains do not charge split
Manual split needs six direct hits, adds two balls, consumes charge, and respects cap
Petal rotation uses a two-second cooldown even while the run is active
A breached cluster costs exactly one life and removes the entire cluster
Three breaches end the run once and time continues for the result animation
Clearing a wave continues the run and progressively increases bounded pressure
Combo expires after an input gap and repeated hits on open buds never score
Fast ball collision uses the moved target and cannot tunnel through it
Passive play after one launch loses without any automatic balls or shots
Fixed input times produce identical outcomes at 30, 60, and 144 FPS
A coarse aim patrol stays within resource bounds; its survival is a balance probe
A controller aiming at threatened relays can clear the first four waves
